feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: How Aldi is pushing down grocery prices
entry.summary: The German-owned chain's low prices are winning over shoppers — and pushing competitors to respond.

entry.title: Polymarket has investigated 'dozens' of election-related cases
entry.summary: The prediction market has hired a former FBI official to make sure political insiders don't use the platform for profit from confidential election information.

entry.title: From ghostwriters to false identities: Our favorite fake music scandals of the 21st century
entry.summary: Controversy over an artist being fake — or someone thinking they are — is hardly new. Here are some of the craziest moments in recent music history when the boundary between real and fake collapsed.

entry.title: Can Black voting power and Trump fatigue break Mississippi's red wall?
entry.summary: Mississippi has the largest proportional Black population in the country. It's one reason the U.S. Senate race has seen millions in last-minute spending and high-profile campaign visits.

entry.title: Is 2026 the fakest year in music?
entry.summary: From an indie darling getting called a "psyop" to plagiarism allegations against a rising pop star, this year feels like an especially fraught time to bicker about authenticity in the music industry.

entry.title: Very chaotic, not at all good: Why does everything in music feel fake right now?
entry.summary: "Is it real?" is the most pressing question in music in 2026, and it's one that feels impossible to adequately answer, in almost any context.

entry.title: Democrats still poised to make gains, but poll shows warning signs for just how many
entry.summary: Democrats hold significant advantages going into Election Day, according to a new NPR/PBS News/Marist poll. But lagging enthusiasm among key groups is just one indicator that gains may not come easy.

entry.title: Harry Kane becomes first Englishman in 25 years to win Ballon d'Or
entry.summary: Kane was followed in the voting by Kylian Mbappé. Spain star Alexia Putellas won her third women's Ballon d'Or. Outside, fans packed the streets and climbed light poles near the London Palladium.

entry.title: Jay-Z picks himself to headline the Super Bowl halftime show in Southern California
entry.summary: The NFL, Apple Music and Roc Nation announced Monday night that Jay-Z will be the featured performer for the halftime festivities on Feb. 14 at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, California.

entry.title: Brewers rout the Rays 10-1 to move within a win of their first World Series title
entry.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers are one victory from their first World Series title after routing the Tampa Bay Rays 10-1 on Monday night thanks to a trio of young players who have shined in October.
